Step %1$d of %2$d
This is your router
WrtControl will manage it from this phone. Check that it is yours.
Asking the router…
OpenWrt version
The app is tested with this version.
Protect your router
Your router has no password. Anyone connected to your network can get into it and change everything, including what you set up here.
Set a password
If you would rather do it later, it is under Security.
Your router has a password. The app keeps it encrypted on this phone and it never leaves it.
What it can do
Anything marked “will be installed” needs a package that the app installs when you turn it on. You don\'t need to know which one.
What will change on your router
Nothing for now. Signing in with the app does not change your router.
When you turn something on (a pause, a filter, access from outside home), the app writes only what is needed and marks it as its own, so in LuCI you can tell it from your own settings.
Every change is checked on the router before it is accepted. If anything fails, or you lose the connection halfway, the router rolls back on its own within a minute.
LuCI keeps working the same: you can use both.
